tldr: Workflow owners can turn on logging. Each run then stores 1 log entry with its result and the step where it stopped. The web app shows the entries in a new logs modal.
goal: Let an owner see whether a workflow ran, and why a run stopped or failed.

story.heading: Workflow runs now write a log entry
story.body: When logging is on, each run stores 1 entry: completed, halted or error. A halted or failed run also stores the step where it stopped.

story.heading: workflow_log table added
story.body: A new table holds the entries. The workflow table gets a logging flag, off by default.

story.heading: A new endpoint reads the log
story.body: GET /workflows/:id/logs returns up to 50 entries, newest first. It filters by result and by date.

story.heading: WorkflowLogs permission added
story.body: Only the owner of the workflow reads its log, with the same check as for a delete.

story.heading: The web app shows the log in a modal
story.body: The modal loads 50 entries at a time through the SDK and loads more as the user scrolls.

story.heading: The whole change
story.body: The change goes through every layer: Web app, SDK, REST API, Workflows, Database. No dependency breaks a rule.

components.summary: New WorkflowLogsModal lists the runs of a workflow, with a filter by result and more entries on scroll.
The OpenAPI patch list knows the new logging field of a workflow.
New getWorkflowLogs call and WorkflowLogEntryDto type; a workflow update takes logging.
New GET /workflows/:id/logs endpoint, guarded by the WorkflowLogs permission.
Each run gets a runId and, when logging is on, stores its result and the step where it stopped.
WorkflowLogs is checked like WorkflowDelete: only the owner of the workflow passes.
New workflow_log table and a logging column on workflow; the repository writes and pages entries.
New WorkflowLogEntryDto and WorkflowGetLogsDto; create and update accept logging.
New WorkflowResult enum: completed, halted or error.

decisions.title: Logging is a per-workflow switch, off by default
decisions.why: A workflow runs on each matching event. A log entry per run grows the table, so the owner turns it on when needed.
decisions.alternative: Log every run of every workflow.

decisions.title: 1 entry per run, with the step where it stopped
decisions.why: The owner sees the result of a run and the step that halted it or failed. A runId groups what belongs to 1 run.
decisions.alternative: 1 entry per step of each run.

decisions.title: Each step runs in its own try block
decisions.why: An error now records the step that failed. Before, 1 try block around all steps lost the step.
decisions.alternative: Keep 1 try block for the whole run.

decisions.title: Pages by date with before, not by offset
decisions.why: New runs add entries at the top. A before date keeps each page stable while the log grows.
